title: ITEM ESP AUTO ATTACK TELEPORT TO TRAIN
features:
gives you item ESP, auto attacks any enemies that get near you with your shovel (attacks WAY faster than if you were to normally attack) , gives you a jump boost, and makes proximity prompts instant. 

Theres also a Button that allows you to instantly teleport back to your train. You can also press Q to teleport back if you are on PC.

Features:
• TELEPORT to the train instantly whenever you want
• FAST AUTO ATTACK 
• ITEM ESP
• JUMP BOOST
